title: host/native/io.lisp fnn-statvfs-free-octets reads statvfs into a 256-octet alien buffer at hard-coded struct offsets (NIL on any platform but x86-64 Linux/OpenBSD and Darwin, so aarch64 Linux observes no free space and ACL2 refuses :temporary-space). Replace its body with fnn-fs-observe-into (host/native/fs-observation.lisp, landed by lane retire at 5828f29ef, no caller yet) and have ACL2 compose the u32 words; needs host/native/fn-fs-observation.c bundled as lib/libfn-fs-observation through tools/build_native_host.sh, build.lisp/build-dtn.lisp, packaging/freeze-native-image.sh, install-native.sh and release-tarball.sh (as libfn-blake3 is). Wave 4 step 1 (primitives).
